name: Green Pin Dee Shackle FN
desc: The Green Pin® Dee Shackle FN is a standard dee shackle with a safety bolt and fixed nut, featuring a bow and pin made of grade 6 high-tensile steel that is quenched and tempered. It has a safety factor where MBL equals 6 x WLL and complies with EN 13889 and ASME B30.26 standards, while also meeting the performance requirements of US Fed. Spec. RR-C-271 Type IVB Class 3, grade A. The shackle is hot-dip galvanized, operates within a temperature range of -40°C up to +200°C, and is certified with 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, MTC, DNV GL 2.7-1, and CE.
standards: US Fed. Spec. RR-C-271 Type IVA Class 3, grade A
